Method of Attack: reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to steal sensitive information and escalate privileges
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Advanced Custom Fields plugin
Attack Vector: exploitation of XSS vulnerability via malicious code run by logged-in users with plugin access
Indicators of Compromise: significant scanning and exploitation activity observed starting 2023-05-06 using Patchstack's proof-of-concept exploit code
